using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
typedef unsigned long long ULL;

//const LL mod=1e9+7;
const double PI=acos(-1);
const double EPS=1e-6;
const int INF=0x3f3f3f3f;
inline int readint(){int sum=0;char c=getchar();bool f=0;while(c<'0'||c>'9'){if(c=='-') f=1;c=getchar();}while(c>='0'&&c<='9'){sum=sum*10+c-'0';c=getchar();}if(f) return -sum;return sum;}
inline LL readLL(){LL sum=0;char c=getchar();bool f=0;while(c<'0'||c>'9'){if(c=='-') f=1;c=getchar();}while(c>='0'&&c<='9'){sum=sum*10+c-'0';c=getchar();}if(f) return -sum;return sum;}

const int maxn=250015;
LL inv[maxn],p[maxn];
void CNumberInit(int MAXNUM,LL mod){
    inv[0]=inv[1]=1;
    p[0]=p[1]=1;
    for(int i=2;i<=MAXNUM;i++){
        inv[i]=(mod-mod/i)*inv[mod%i]%mod;
        p[i]=p[i-1]*i%mod;
    }
    for(int i=2;i<=MAXNUM;i++) inv[i]=inv[i-1]*inv[i]%mod;
}

LL qmod(LL a,LL b,LL c){
    LL ret=1;
    for(;b;b>>=1){
        if(b&1) ret=ret*a%c;
        a=a*a%c;
    }
    return ret;
}

vector<int> megumi;
LL mod;
int k;
LL dp[20][250005];

int main(){ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);cin.tie(0);
    LL n;cin>>n>>k>>mod;
    CNumberInit(n+5,mod);
    if(n%2){
        cout<<qmod(k,n,mod)<<endl;
    }else{
        for(int i=2;i<=n;i+=2){
            if((i&n)==i) megumi.push_back(i);
        }
        LL ans=0;
        dp[0][n]=1;
        for(int i=1;i<=min(17,k);i++){
            int tmpans=0;
            for(int j=0;j<megumi.size();j++){
                if(!dp[i-1][megumi[j]]) continue;
                int Megumi=megumi[j]&(megumi[j]-1);
                int step=Megumi^megumi[j];
                for(int k=step;k<=Megumi;k+=step){
                    if((k&Megumi)==k){
                        dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][megumi[j]]*p[megumi[j]]%mod
                            *inv[k]%mod*inv[megumi[j]-k]%mod;
                        dp[i][k]%=mod;
                    }
                }
                tmpans=(tmpans+dp[i-1][megumi[j]])%mod;
            }
            ans+=tmpans*inv[k-i]%mod;
        }
        ans=ans*p[k]%mod;
        ans=qmod(k,n,mod)-ans;
        ans=(ans%mod+mod)%mod;
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
